title: "Live demo"
output: rmarkdown::html_document

These showcase apps of `unsaved` run in your browser. There is no
server: [shinylive](https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/) runs R and
Shiny in the page with webR. Records stay in memory for this session only.

## Lab result review

Edit a fictional study's results and save your review with a reason for change.
The table, status and note share one tracker; the app stores the audit trail.

Things to try:

* Double-click a result value and change it. Watch the table marker and badge.
* Set **Review status** and write a **Review note**, then click **Save review**.
  Enter a reason and save. Open **Audit trail** to see one row per changed field.
* Edit again and click **Changes**. Choose **Keep editing** or **Save and leave**.
  Save and leave asks for a reason and shows **Saving...** during the short delay.
* Try **Discard changes**, or select another batch and click **Load batch**.
  Loading asks before replacing unsaved edits.

```{=html}
<div class="unsaved-live-demo">
  <iframe src="../review/" title="Lab result review demo" loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>
<p class="small text-muted">
  <a href="../review/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in a new tab</a>
</p>
```

To run the review app on your own machine:

```r
shiny::runApp(system.file("examples/review", package = "unsaved"))
```

## Team profile editor

Things to try:

* Edit the name. Watch the dot, the badge and the saved/current value list.
* Click **Discard changes**, then edit again and click **Save profile**.
* Edit a field and click **Preferences**. Try **Keep editing**, **Discard
  changes** and **Save and leave** in the dialog.
* Click **Add a contact note**. Its first value is saved; edit it to see a dot.
* Select Sam and click **Load another record**. If you have unsaved changes,
  a dialog asks you to keep editing, discard, or save and leave.
  Visit **Saved profile** to see what the app stored.

```{=html}
<div class="unsaved-live-demo">
  <iframe src="../demo/" title="unsaved live demo" loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>
<p class="small text-muted">
  <a href="../demo/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in a new tab</a>
</p>
```

To run the same demo on your own machine:

```r
shiny::runApp(system.file("examples/demo", package = "unsaved"))
```
